It identifies a geometry-leakage confound because orbital proxies come from target geometry while the plain baseline has no 3D information, then runs a matched-capacity geometry-only control plus a scrambled-feature control. Geometry-only is worse than plain and stereo beats it in all four seeds, so the identified confound is directly challenged by a discriminating control; the review is rewritten to the remaining modest statistical-power caveat and the claim is correspondingly qualified.

candidate_027_refinement.name: issue-ledger review-closure invariant
candidate_027_refinement.new_evidence: The Opus trajectory provides a positive within-trajectory closure example: an explicit geometry-leakage concern is converted into a matched geometry-only discriminating control, evidence changes, and the reviewer is rewritten. Qwen provides the complementary failure: an earlier severe leakage issue is repaired, but a later energy-derived-feature confound remains open, so promotion must close again.
candidate_027_refinement.refined_rule: A severe issue closes only when the repair directly discriminates the implicated alternative explanation or all load-bearing claims are materially narrowed/blocked. Closure is issue-specific and non-monotonic: discovering a new severe issue re-closes the promotion gate even after a prior repair succeeded.
candidate_027_refinement.scope_guard: Observed process evidence within one benchmark panel; not a matched intervention showing a system-level outcome gain.
